gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-noto-sans-khar: Approachable unclosed curves sit under Red Hat Display's bold marker stroke. And Noto Sans Kharoshthi, a sans-serif, does the dark lowercase stripe, while the heading owns the daylight shout.
gen-boska-fs-supreme: Supreme, a plain sans, lays a heavy mid-strip of text, letters held open, under Boska's carved stems. Carved serifs beside that open strip feel bookish then crisp.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-pt-sans-caption: Unclosed, inviting bowls and big-bodied small letters make PT Sans Caption read contemporary under packed Oswald. PT Sans Caption walks running copy without snagging on a closed bowl.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-noto-sans-khme: Clean chisel-notch openings sit under Red Hat Display's marker stroke, with small letters standing almost capital-sized. Noto Sans Khmer, a plain sans, walks running copy without a snag.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-puritan: Marker-round titles with a clear path around each bend: Chubbo looks casual over Puritan. Puritan, a sans-serif, brings the snap: vinyl-flat heading stroke against those oversized open counters.
gen-boska-general-sans: Steady pen pressure and a line-filling x-height make General Sans read clean under Boska's glass serifs. Boska does carved drama; General Sans does the unshaded outline.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Chubbo draws casual marker-tip letters with a smooth path around every bend. Schibsted Grotesk, a plain sans, brings the snap: drafting-pen heading against those open e bowls.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-noto-sans-kr: Marker-traced titles, hollow curves: Red Hat Display looks contemporary and bold. Noto Sans KR, a sans, walks running copy with generous curve gaps and stubby extenders beside a big x-height.
gen-boska-manrope: Chunky stems with filament-thin connectors, like a lightbulb wire, mark Boska. And Manrope, a sans-serif, does the unchanging pen line and bright curve gaps, while Boska owns the carved shout.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-sono: High-bodied small letters and wide spacing make Sono read approachable. Oswald's packed rows plus that ajar-mouthed sans-serif line share one sheet of type without crowding each other.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-noto-sans-lao-: Red Hat Display holds a marker stroke that never mixes weights. Noto Sans Lao Looped, a plain sans, does the solid-block words and unfinished bowls, while the heading owns the shout.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-sulphur-point: Distinct open gaps and bulky small letters make Sulphur Point read steady. Sulphur Point, a sans-serif, walks running copy on a marker-like line under Chubbo's smooth bends.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-stack-sans-text: Stack Sans Text, a plain sans, holds a marker-like line under Oswald. The snap is packed display rows against that cable-constant stroke, curve endings kept apart, and big-bodied small letters.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-tiktok-sans: A smooth, unobstructed path around each bend, drawn as if with a marker tip, marks Chubbo. TikTok Sans, a sans-serif, feels modern beside those casual rounds, x-height nearly cap-high.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-ubuntu-sans: Tightly knit rows of text mark Oswald as strong, packed display type. And Ubuntu Sans, a sans-serif, adds washer-wide eyes and copper-pipe strokes, so packed titles meet tubular copy.
